title: Path of Exile 2 0.3.0 Support Gem Overhaul: Removed Limit, Repeatable Supports, Tiers & Build Migration
summary: 0.3.0 removed the 'one Support per character, once' limit, made Supports repeatable, added tiers to several, merged some old values, and added 11 new Supports. Here is the old rule, the new rule, and how to migrate old builds.
description: A focused history of the 0.3.0 Support Gem overhaul for Skills and Builds: the removed one-per-character limit, repeatable Supports, added tiers, merged effects, 11 new Supports, and a migration checklist for pre-0.3.0 builds.
author: StratLore Editorial
imageAlt: Path of Exile 2 Witchhunter casting an explosive skill

sections.title: Old rule (pre-0.3.0)
sections.oldText: Each Support Gem could be used at most once per character. A second copy of the same Support in another link was inert.
sections.newText: Supports are repeatable across links; several have added tiers; 11 new Supports exist.

changes.title: Repeatable Supports
changes.detail: The same Support can appear in multiple skill links on one character, enabling stacking strategies that were impossible before.

changes.title: Added tiers
changes.detail: Multiple Supports gained an additional tier, broadening scaling and build options.

changes.title: Merged values/effects
changes.detail: Some older Support values or effects were consolidated, changing how certain links were previously valued.

changes.title: 11 new Supports
changes.detail: A batch of new Supports expanded build crafting, several tied to reworked systems.

rows.thenText: Pre-0.3.0: you had to spread unique Supports across skills; duplicates were wasted.
rows.nowText: 0.3.0+: duplicate Supports are valid; plan for stacking where it pays off.

rows.thenText: Pre-0.3.0: one tier per Support capped stacking.
rows.nowText: 0.3.0+: added tiers raise the ceiling for tiered Supports.

rows.thenText: Pre-0.3.0: 'only one of X' defined many builds.
rows.nowText: 0.3.0+: that constraint is gone; evaluate links on value, not scarcity.

steps.from: Old layout with one copy of each Support
steps.to: Re-evaluate duplicate Supports in key links
steps.note: Duplicates are now valid; check if stacking beats a unique alternative.

steps.to: Re-pull current Support values from the Skill/Support page
steps.note: Merged values changed previously assumed math.

steps.to: Account for added tiers on tiered Supports
steps.note: Tiers raise the scaling ceiling; re-simulate DPS.
Old videos show the one-per-character era; do not copy verbatim.

rows.currentSummary: Removed in 0.3.0; Supports are repeatable in 0.5.4e.
The tiers added in 0.3.0 remain; later balance may have adjusted numbers.
The new Supports added in 0.3.0 remain available in 0.5.4e.

reports.context: Players celebrated being able to double up Supports.
reports.quote: Finally can run two of the same Support without it being dead.
reports.analysis: Confirms the limit removal; current builds should use repeatable Supports freely.

reports.context: Old guides listed 'one of each Support' as a hard rule.
reports.quote: You can only use each Support once, plan around it.
reports.analysis: Obsolete after 0.3.0; flag such guides as pre-overhaul.
